verses.sale: By the brightness of the morning

verses.t: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness
verses.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest
verses.yusufAli: And by the Night when it is still
verses.rodwell: And by the night when it darkeneth
verses.sale: and by the night, when it groweth dark

verses.t: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee
verses.yusufAli: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased
verses.rodwell: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee, neither hath he been displeased
verses.sale: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee, neither doth He hate thee

verses.t: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]
verses.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former
verses.yusufAli: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present
verses.rodwell: And surely the Future shall be better for thee than the Past
verses.sale: Verily the life to come shall be better for thee than this present life

verses.t: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
verses.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content
verses.yusufAli: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased
verses.rodwell: And in the end shall thy Lord be bounteous to thee and thou be satisfied
verses.sale: And thy Lord shall give thee a reward wherewith thou shalt be well pleased

verses.t: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)
verses.yusufAli: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)
verses.rodwell: Did he not find thee an orphan and gave thee a home
verses.sale: Did He not find thee an orphan, and hath He not taken care of thee

verses.t: And He found you lost and guided [you]
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)
verses.yusufAli: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance
verses.rodwell: And found thee erring and guided thee
verses.sale: And did He not find thee wandering in error, and hath He not guided thee into the truth

verses.t: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)
verses.yusufAli: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent
verses.rodwell: And found thee needy and enriched thee
verses.sale: And did He not find thee needy, and hath He not enriched thee

verses.t: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]
verses.yusufAli: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness
verses.rodwell: As to the orphan therefore wrong him not

verses.t: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]
verses.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away
verses.rodwell: And as to him that asketh of thee, chide him not away

verses.t: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]
verses.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse
verses.yusufAli: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim
verses.rodwell: And as for the favours of thy Lord tell them abroad
verses.sale: But declare the goodness of thy Lord
